title: Clause pauses of 0.8, 1.2, 1.8 and 3 s between complete clauses

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Good afternoon, you've reached the booking desk. How can I help?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Hi there, I booked a slot for next week <0.8s> and I'd like to check a couple of details on it.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Happy to check those for you. I can see the slot you booked right here. Which details did you want to go over?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: The first thing is the time, <1.2s> because I remember it being in the morning.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: It is in the morning, at half past nine. You will get a reminder the day before as well. What is the second thing?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: The second thing is the location. <1.8s> I want to make sure it's the branch on the high street.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: It is the high street branch, yes. The entrance is on the side road, and there is parking behind the building. Anything else you would like me to confirm?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: No, I think that covers everything. <3s> Actually, could you also tell me how early I should arrive?

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Arriving about ten minutes early is plenty. That gives you time to check in at the front desk before your slot starts. Is there anything else?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: That's everything, thank you. Bye now.
